encyclopedia.summary: Written by Kazuo Koike and drawn by Goseki Kojima, serialised in Weekly Manga Action from 1970 to 1976. The executioner Itto travels with his small son Daigoro, taking the shogunate's darkest jobs while hunting the clan that destroyed his family. A toddler in a blood-soaked setting and precise period detail set the standard for samurai manga after it.
highlights: Pushes revenge and child-rearing at once through a father-and-toddler pair.
Draws the speed of a draw and the spilling of blood like still life, changing period drama's grammar.
Adapted to film and television many times and became a reference for later samurai manga.

related.note: A manga about an immortal in the same era
A hardboiled lead from the same magazine generation
Organisation and revenge moved to another era

encyclopedia.summary: Takao Saito's manga has run in Big Comic since 1968: an omnibus about Duke Togo, a sniper with no name or nationality, taking aim at the world's powerful. It borrows real political and economic cases, treating the craft of the shot and the state of the world as one subject. More than fifty years of serialisation gave it records for volume count and print run.
highlights: Adapts real cases and figures so the background of each shot is international politics.
Barely shows the lead's feelings, only the arithmetic of the job.
Its long run set Japanese manga records for serialisation length and volume count.

related.note: Hardboiled work of the same generation — professionals doing a job
Hardboiled manga about politics and organisation
A long-form build of an international conspiracy

encyclopedia.summary: A Korean webtoon written by Geobalhan and drawn by Han Jung-wol, running since 2020. Cheon Yeo-woon, a fallen martial artist, receives nanomachines sent by a descendant and reshapes the martial world's factions. The machines do not replace martial arts; they change the conditions under which it can be trained.
highlights: Sect and clan interests re-sort themselves around one new variable, and that takes a long time to play out.
The tension comes less from how fast the lead grows than from how the factions want to use him.
It keeps the vocabulary of wuxia while inserting a science-fiction device.
